description: This file defines a class SineVoice that extends SawVoice and overrides the createOscillator method to return a SineOscillator, replacing a sawtooth wave with a sine wave in a MIDI synthesis context.

classes.name: SineVoice
classes.description: A subclass of SawVoice that creates a sine wave oscillator instead of a sawtooth wave.

methods.name: createOscillator
methods.description: Overrides the base method to instantiate and return a SineOscillator.
